name: Software Engineering Metrics
description: A working book about measuring software engineering well: 47 metric topics across 8 parts, plus front matter and appendices. Every metric family names its gaming vector and the guardrail that catches it, because of Goodhart's law: a measure that becomes a target stops being a good measure.

conventions.sourceOfTruth: locales/en-gb-oxendict/ (the other English locales are derived mechanically)
conventions.topicNumbering: Parts are whole numbers; topics are decimals (N.0 introduces part N, N.1, N.2, ... follow).
